descriptions.w3d_d24g_input_turn_aim_actions_80054434: Appends input actions to the owner's pointer vector at +36: Input.TurnLeftPressed (0, 1), Input.TurnLeftReleased (0, 0), Input.TurnRightPressed (1, 1), Input.TurnRightReleased (1, 0), Input.AimUpPressed (3, 1), Input.AimUpReleased (3, 0), Input.AimDownPressed (2, 1), Input.AimDownReleased (2, 0). Each entry is (action, enabled[, axis]); button actions mode 2, axis actions mode 1.
